ukmt-stmc-2015-16-final-group-01.prompt: A right-angled triangle has hypotenuse of length $2080$ and a shorter side of length $2016$. The third side has length $2^n$. What is the value of $n$?

ukmt-stmc-2015-16-final-group-02a.prompt: What is the least positive integer which leaves remainder $1$ when divided by $7$ and remainder $2$ when divided by $11$?

ukmt-stmc-2015-16-final-group-02b.prompt: What is the least positive integer which leaves remainder $1$ when divided by $7$, remainder $2$ when divided by $11$ and remainder $3$ when divided by $13$?

ukmt-stmc-2015-16-final-group-03.prompt: $ABCD$ is a square with side length $1$. A semi-circle with diameter $CD$ is drawn on the interior of $ABCD$ as shown. The point $E$ on $DA$ is such that line $BE$ is a tangent to the semi-circle. What is the area of the triangle $ABE$?

ukmt-stmc-2015-16-final-group-04a.prompt:
Anya, Boris, Chiara and Derek played 'two-a-side' football in the park. In each round one team, made up of two attackers, tries to score a goal. The other team, made up of one defender and one goalkeeper, tries to stop them. They played a series of rounds with each round ending after a goal was scored. The player who scored the goal became the goalkeeper in the next round with the other positions determined at random.

When they stopped playing, Anya had been the goalkeeper nine times, Boris had not been the goalkeeper in thirteen of the rounds, Chiara had not been the goalkeeper in fourteen of the rounds and Derek had been an attacker in sixteen rounds but never played as defender.

How many rounds were played altogether?

ukmt-stmc-2015-16-final-group-04b.prompt:
Anya, Boris, Chiara and Derek played 'two-a-side' football in the park. In each round one team, made up of two attackers, tries to score a goal. The other team, made up of one defender and one goalkeeper, tries to stop them. They played a series of rounds with each round ending after a goal was scored. The player who scored the goal became the goalkeeper in the next round with the other positions determined at random.

When they stopped playing, Anya had been the goalkeeper nine times, Boris had not been the goalkeeper in thirteen of the rounds, Chiara had not been the goalkeeper in fourteen of the rounds and Derek had been an attacker in sixteen rounds but never played as defender.

Who scored the goal in the sixth round?

ukmt-stmc-2015-16-final-group-05.prompt: A rectangular piece of paper has its corners at $A$, $B$, $C$ and $D$. The length of $CD$ is $12$ cm. The paper is folded so that the corner that was at $A$ now coincides with $C$ to form the pentagon $B'CDEF$, as shown. The length of $EF$ is $15$ cm. What is the perimeter of the pentagon $B'CDEF$, in cm?

ukmt-stmc-2015-16-final-group-07a.prompt: Ernie is celebrating his $18$th birthday today. He notices his age is a factor of $2016$. In what year is the next time that his age on his birthday is a factor of the year?

ukmt-stmc-2015-16-final-group-07b.prompt: Frida and Graham (both younger than $80$ years in age) realise that if they write their two-digit ages next to each other (Frida's first), they form a four-digit square. Graham realises that they will be able to achieve a similar feat in exactly $17$ years' time. How old is Frida?

ukmt-stmc-2015-16-final-group-08.prompt: Incapability Green has a set of five square lawns around two seating areas that are right-angled triangles in shape and two triangular flowerbeds. One of the seating areas is bounded by a square pond and the two smallest lawns (see figure). The total area of the five lawns is $2016$ m$^2$. What is the area of the pond in m$^2$?

ukmt-stmc-2015-16-final-group-09a.prompt: Using the digits $0,1,2,3,4$ and $5$ no more than once each, how many five-digit even numbers can be formed?

ukmt-stmc-2015-16-final-group-09b.prompt: What is the sum of all four-digit integers whose digits are all odd numbers?

ukmt-stmc-2015-16-final-group-10.prompt: A two-digit Keith number '$ab$' is a number that appears in the sequence generated from the recurrence relation $u_{n+2}=u_{n+1}+u_n$ for $n\ge1$; $u_1=a$, $u_2=b$. For example, $14$ is a Keith number since $14$ appears in the sequence $1,4,5,9,14,23,\dots$. In fact, $14$ is the first Keith number. The third Keith number is $28$. Coincidentally, the fourth Keith number is the sum of the second and third Keith numbers. What is the fourth Keith number?
